message.heading: Message from the Representative
message.paragraph1: We founded Traveling Tokyo with a deep-seated passion to share the unparalleled charm and authentic culture of Japan with the world.
message.paragraph2: Drawing from extensive overseas experience and the global perspective gained from studies at UCLA, our journey into entrepreneurship was driven by a desire to create unforgettable experiences that go beyond typical tourism, connecting travelers with the heart and soul of Tokyo and Japan.

philosophy.heading: Our Philosophy
philosophy.missionText: To deliver unforgettable 'Japan experiences' that stay with you long after your trip.
philosophy.visionText: To become the No.1 brand from Tokyo, globally recognized for 'experiences.'

values.title: Speed is King
values.description: Prioritize action and iteration over waiting for perfection. Prompt response is fundamental to building customer trust.

values.title: Challenge with Courage
values.description: Embrace new areas, roles, and ideas. Our evolution is fueled by a positive attitude towards change and continuous challenge.

values.title: Own the Brand
values.description: The trust placed in 'Traveling Tokyo' by others rests on your individual words and actions. Each of us embodies the brand.

members.name: Yota Koketsu
members.intro: Born in 2000. Graduated from UCLA (University of California, Los Angeles) Global Studies in 2023. Grew up in multicultural environments, spending his childhood in Hong Kong, Kyoto, and the UK. After engaging in international business in the US, he returned to Japan and founded the company with the aim of delivering Japan's charm as an 'experience' to the world. He has realized a high-quality tourism experience model by optimizing SNS, OTA, and operations in-house. Founder of a tourism startup.
